subject: Native sweep 2026-09-02: two standing HIGHs + eleven new items (Mac lane owns the builds)
body:
Native sweep 2026-09-02 (cloud lane, read-only at 61b4d34) — Mac lane owns these; ledger with line numbers is in this message.

Still standing (sent before): DeviceInfo.swift env-as-MDM facts (serial/udid/isSupervised/isKioskMode from ProcessInfo; the serial feeds SecurityManager's binding key and BackendService posts is_supervised/is_kiosk_mode); HybridIdentityProvider primaryProvider/secondaryProvider never assigned (IdentityProvider.swift:598-599; authenticate() builds an OIDC provider at :616 and discards it).

New:
- MockSignalGridAPI.swift:318 is a second decision engine (10 reason codes mirrored from lib/signalgrid-core, no parity gate); WardlinkModel.swift:22 hard-wires it. Cloud lane will extend check-decision-port-parity.mjs with the mock's reason-code set; Mac lane: consider replayed vectors instead of re-derived rules.
- BadgeReaderProvider.swift:207 registers "usbc" but BadgeReaderType has no such rawValue → USBCBadgeReaderProvider.swift (320 lines) is unreachable. Add `case usbC = "usbc"` or delete both.
- PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION.md lists nfc/serial (badge) and saml/custom (identity) as Available; no class exists; createProvider returns nil silently. Mark declared-not-implemented and make createProvider throw/log.
- ProviderConfigurationService.swift:92 promises a UserDefaults fallback that does not exist; ConfigKeys unreferenced → a shipped device has no config path for badge/identity providers. Implement via Managed App Config (KioskConfig.managed* pattern) or delete the comment + enum.
- KioskController.swift:9 uses AutonomousSingleAppModePermittedAppIDs; mobileconfig:44, MDM_CONFIGURATION §2, FLEET_MDM §b use autonomousSingleAppModePermittedAppIDs. Adjudicate against Apple's Restrictions payload schema and make all four agree.
- BackendService.swift:73 posts /api/sessions/start; the served route is /api/v1/sessions/start (app.ts:124 mounts /api; routes/v1.ts:256). Verify on the simulator; if it 404s, that is a live wire bug.
- native/ios/README.md: build block says `cd ios` / `-sdk ipados` (invalid); ~225 lines (240-465) document endpoints/env that exist in no repo; "the app enforces" contradicts rule 4; Android marked future; desktop marked macOS (it is Windows/Linux); licence line says Proprietary while LICENSE is MIT. Cloud lane takes the prose fixes; Mac lane takes anything that needs a build.
- Cargo.toml license = "UNLICENSED" in firmware/dock/core, native/desktop/app, native/desktop/core vs MIT LICENSE/NOTICE. Cloud lane fixes.
- DemoMode.swift defines 18 flags, docs name 6; -SimulateBadge documented in DemoMode.swift but implemented in LockedIdleViewController:142. Cloud lane adds a flag table; Mac lane verifies each flag still fires on the simulator.
- Fossils: CONVERGENCE.md "8 core tests" (14 on disk), VERIFICATION.md "6 tests" (as-of 2026-07-24), settings.gradle.kts:55 "40 tests" (43), FILES.txt missing two files (nothing regenerates it). Cloud lane fixes.
Not verified from the cloud: equalToConstant on scaling rows at accessibility-extra-large (view controllers not read); every native build.
